snippet.title: Gothic 1 Remake | Making Of #03: Art Vision
snippet.description:
“We used the Baroque style for the approach of light, colour, the darkness, the aesthetic of Baroque in all of its stages and all of its eras.”

Join the team at Alkimia Interactive and take a look behind the scenes of Gothic 1 Remake, diving deep into the challenges of reviving a cult classic RPG. From preserving the essence of the original, whilst setting Gothic 1 Remake up for a completely overhauled and overworked art vision.
